Product card versions

Each client store picks one with sections.productCard. Same data, same tokens; only the card changes.

A

Classic

Today's card

sections.productCard = "classic"

Pick it for a balanced catalogue: a square photo, the price and a clear Add to cart button. It is the card the store ships with today.

C

Detailed

sections.productCard = "detailed"

Pick it for considered purchases, where shoppers compare details before they buy: category, one key attribute and a separate wishlist button.
